items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: where Hines was my idol... Nat reminded me so very much of Hines... You could tell he was greatly influenced by Hines

ctx.x: But Nat, as I say, he had this marvelous band, and at that time he wasn't singing. I hadn't heard him sing a note, because he played so marvelously well. I just loved his piano playing. He just knocked everybody out, you know. He could just play, man, up a breeze, you know. And I guess the one reason I liked him so well was because he reminded me -- at that time he sort of reminded me a little bit of Hines, , he had a great deal of Hines, you know.
